description_en: Queries the list of AI image processing tasks
description_zh: 调用本接口查询AI图片任务列表
name: GetAIImageJobs

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of AI image processing tasks. The value consists of one or more job IDs. A job ID is the value of the JobId parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186922.html operation.
A maximum of 10 IDs are supported.
Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
AI图片处理任务ID。由一个或多个JobId组成，JobId为调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186922.html接口返回参数JobId的值。
最多支持10个ID。
多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: job_ids

AIImageJobList.description_en: The list of AI image processing tasks

items.description_en: The details of an AI image processing task

AIImageResult.description_en:
The OSS URL of the AI image.
This is the task result. The URL does not contain complete authentication information. To obtain authentication information, generate it yourself or call the [ListAIImage]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186924.html） operation to retrieve the media asset result
AIImageResult.description_zh:
AI图片的OSS地址。
为任务结果，因此该地址不提供完整的鉴权信息，需要鉴权信息需用户生成或者调用[ListAIImage]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186924.html）接口获取媒资结果

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the AI image processing task was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: AI图片处理任务的创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

JobId.description_en: The ID of the AI image processing task

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
success: The task is successful.
fail: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态：
success：成功。
fail：失败

TemplateConfig.description_en: The snapshot of the configuration information of the specified template when the task was submitted
TemplateConfig.description_zh: 提交任务时，对指定模板的配置信息的快照

UserData.description_en:
The custom settings.
The value must be a JSON string.
The value must contain the MessageCallback or Extend parameter.
The maximum length is 512 bytes.

For more information about the parameter structure, see [UserData]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html）
UserData.description_zh:
自定义设置。
必须是JSON字符串。
需要包含MessageCallback或者Extend参数。
最大长度为512个字节。

参数构造详情，请参见[UserData]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html）
